note: Fails if set presentation is missing, member sorting uses labels/names or reverses axes, facet labels do not default to their values, or tags omit a non-first member. Oracle is authored webapp-dev curation and source labels. Fails if a set shadows the same-slug variable, a malformed set/ ref is accepted, or a well-formed absent set is malformed, or members omit their columns. Namespace and refusal expectations follow the set/ ruling. Bare set and a register-final set are ordinary variable refs; only leading set/ selects the set namespace.
